verdict.gate: DO NOT REUSE folder_trash AS A PRE-FILTER — it is contaminated with real customer mail
verdict.sample_read: ~12-13 of 25 are genuine customer/business threads (quote requests, approvals, spec discussions, follow-ups) from real customer domains incl. Studio Odea, Fourth Wall, UNSW, Delivery, monogram.partners, Society of the Sacred Heart, Cartier. The rest: newsletters, calendar accepts, file-transfer notifications, utility/vendor noise, internal ops.
verdict.aggregate_corroboration: Top trash sender domains are dominated by CUSTOMER domains — hhglobal.com (342), thepropertyagency.com.au (216), centuria.com.au (263), emilyziz.com (223), fourthwall, frostcollective, curriegroup, unsw.edu.au, integritylife — i.e. TOP customers. Only 7% are noreply/mailer/bounce (the truly safe skip pattern); 41% internal carbon8 (mixed ops); ~52% external, much of it real.
verdict.root_cause: folder=Trash here reflects AM mailbox HYGIENE (handled-then-deleted) and sync of the Trash folder, NOT irrelevance. Folder location is not a relevance signal for this client.
verdict.impact: ~42K emails skipped on folder_trash; at ~50% real that is ~20K genuine customer threads (quotes, approvals) currently invisible to ALL intent/AI-dependent insight. This is LARGER than Nic's 16K no-row gap.

recommendation.drop_filter: Remove folder_trash from the pre-filter skip set.
recommendation.keep_filters: KEEP content-based skips (spam, bounce_or_delivery_failure, rule_based_or_auto_reply, automated_pattern, trivial_body, forward_only, folder_drafts, noreply/mailer-pattern) — those are legitimate.
recommendation.reextraction_scope: Re-include the ~42K folder_trash emails, run them through the CONTENT pre-filters (drops the ~50% genuine junk), recovering ~20K real customer emails. Combined real target = Nic 16K no-row + ~20K recovered-from-trash ~= 36K emails ~= $36 at $0.001. Still nowhere near $400.
recommendation.caveat_on_prior_work: metadata analyses (revenue-at-risk, open-quotes) used the emails table directly and were unaffected; only intent/AI-dependent views (intent mix, won/lost intent) were missing this ~20K — those may shift slightly once trash is re-classified.
